en: Color postcard showing a serene mountain lake surrounded by dense conifer forest. In the foreground, four children sit on a rock fishing. Across the lake stands a lakeside building with two small red conical towers and red roof, plus a boathouse and a footbridge. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian 40 Bani stamp, and the printed caption identifying the location.
